title: Three Summers and One Short Seed
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（人与社会·科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（人与社会·科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：gene　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gene 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the breeder ① traced a gene that no assistant in the field would have described, and he said the tracing was the whole of the summer. The ② gene, meaning the segment itself and not the cell, ran three summers and stayed undescribed in the book; a gene, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ gene in that field had the same short seed beside it, and the ④ gene at the far row, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A gene, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the breeder said the describing is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the gene was the whole of the matter, meaning the inheritance and not the segment. The ⑥ gene, meaning the inheritance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; gene, he said, is either something you trace or the only word that means both a segment and an inheritance. He said the inheritance is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ gene had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short seed. The ⑧ gene of the whole thing, the breeder wrote in November, was one field and three summers of describing; gene, he said, is either the one at the far row or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ gene I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1982 and is still described as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ gene, my mother said in 1984, is the only one that improves by being described; every gene, she said, is an inheritance that has agreed to look like a segment. She said the inheritance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 基因（指田里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 基因（指那一段序列本身，与细胞相对）
C. 固定搭配：trace a gene 追踪一个基因
D. n. 基因（指留给孩子们观察的那一个）

F. n. 基因（指图谱里标出、被记录过的那一个）

items.q: traced a gene that no assistant in the field would have described

answers.why: trace a gene 意为“追踪一个基因”，1975 年那位育种员追踪了田里没有一位助手肯描述的一个基因。
gene 意为“基因”，指那一段序列本身而不是细胞，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被描述。
gene 意为“基因”，指田里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一粒矮矮的种子。
gene 意为“基因”，指最远那一行留给孩子们观察的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
gene 意为“遗传因子、禀赋”，指一件事里人人都带却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份禀赋就是那件事的全部。
gene 意为“禀赋”，指人人都带却无人提起的那样东西而不是那一段序列，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
gene 意为“基因”，指图谱里标出、被记录过的那一个，到 1980 年这一个成了方案里的一行。
gene 意为“基因”，育种员十一月写道，整件事的遗传之事是一片田和三个夏天的描述。
gene 意为“基因”，我记得的是方案里描述过的那一个，1982 年记录完了，至今仍被说成田里最安静的一个。
gene 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，一个基因是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
